groups.label: When to buy
groups.caption: A coin must pass all of these

dials.label: Buy new coins
dials.help: Off pauses new buys. Open positions are still managed and sold.

dials.label: Pull the Radar every
dials.help: How often the bot fetches the Radar from the site.

dials.label: Fast feed
dials.help: Ask the tracker to send every 3 seconds while the bot runs, as it does when the Radar page is open. Uses more of the site's daily request allowance.

dials.label: Live prices for open positions
dials.help: Check open positions against DexScreener between pulls so stops react in seconds.

dials.label: Live price check every
dials.help: Only used while a position is open.

dials.label: Starting cash
dials.help: Used the next time the account is reset.

dials.label: Radar signal required
dials.help: Which of the Radar's own picks the bot may buy.

dials.label: Minimum setup score
dials.help: The Radar's 0 to 100 score.

dials.label: Maximum price gain, 5 minutes
dials.help: Skip coins that already ran this far. 0 means no limit.

dials.label: Minimum viewer growth
dials.help: Viewers gained per minute.

dials.label: Minimum liquidity
dials.help: Coins with no liquidity figure are skipped unless this is 0.

dials.label: Maximum market cap
dials.help: 0 means no limit.

dials.label: Minimum share of buys, 5 minutes
dials.help: Buys as a share of all trades.

dials.label: Maximum coin age
dials.help: 0 means no limit.

dials.label: Riskiest safety rating allowed
dials.help: The RugCheck rating on the Radar.

dials.label: Minimum quality score
dials.help: Holder quality from the Pulse checklist. Coins with no score are skipped unless this is 0.

dials.label: Most failed quality checks
dials.help: Top 10, dev, snipers, insiders, bundlers, fees, dev record, holders, authorities.

dials.label: Skip coins with a Radar warning
dials.help: Liquidity pulled, a sharp dump, or risky authorities.

dials.label: Oldest data to buy on
dials.help: No buys while the Radar or a coin's last reading is older than this.

dials.label: Pulls in a row before buying
dials.help: A coin must pass on this many pulls in a row, so a one-off flicker is ignored.

dials.label: Wait before buying the same coin again
Most buys of one coin in 24 hours
Minimum runner chance
dials.help: The learner's chance that this coin becomes a runner. 0 turns this off.

dials.label: Minimum could-explode chance
dials.help: From viewer bursts. 0 turns this off.

dials.label: Minimum big-winner chance
dials.help: From the coins that made the biggest gains. 0 turns this off.

choices: Buy at any point in a run
Skip coins past their usual crash time
Also skip coins near their usual crash time
dials.label: Crash timing
dials.help: Uses the learner's expected life for coins like this one.

dials.label: Minimum time left before the usual crash
dials.help: 0 turns this off.

dials.label: When a prediction is not ready
dials.help: Applies only to the learned rules turned on above.

dials.label: Risk strength
dials.help: Scales every bet and how much of the account can be in coins at once. 5 uses the numbers below as written, 10 doubles them, 1 uses a fifth.

dials.label: Bet per trade
dials.help: At risk strength 5.

dials.label: Largest single bet
dials.help: A hard cap, whatever the risk strength.

dials.label: Largest single bet in dollars
dials.help: 0 means no dollar cap.

dials.label: Smallest bet worth making
dials.help: Smaller bets are skipped.

dials.label: Most of the account in coins
dials.help: At risk strength 5.

dials.label: Largest bet against a coin's liquidity
dials.help: Keeps bets small enough to get out of.

dials.label: Bet more on stronger setups
dials.help: Half size at the minimum score, up to one and a half times at a perfect score or learned chance.

dials.label: Daily loss limit
dials.help: No more buys today once the account is down this much. 0 turns this off.

dials.label: Drawdown stop
dials.help: No more buys while the account is this far below its high. 0 turns this off.

dials.label: Losses in a row before a break
dials.help: 0 turns this off.

dials.label: Most buys in an hour
dials.help: 0 means no limit.

dials.label: Stop loss
dials.help: Sell when the price is this far below the entry. 0 turns this off.

dials.label: Profit target
dials.help: 0 turns this off.

dials.label: Share sold at the profit target
dials.help: The rest rides on the trailing stop.

dials.label: Protect the entry price after the target
dials.help: Once the target is hit, sell the rest if the price falls back to the entry.

dials.label: Trailing stop
dials.help: Sell when the price falls this far from its high since buying. 0 turns this off.

dials.label: Trailing stop starts after a gain of
Longest time to hold
dials.help: 0 means no limit.

dials.label: Sell a stalled trade after
dials.help: 0 turns this off.

dials.label: A trade is stalled below a gain of
Sell when the score falls below
dials.help: 0 turns this off.

dials.label: Sell when viewers fall
dials.help: Measured from the most viewers seen since buying. 0 turns this off.

dials.label: Sell on a Radar warning
dials.help: Liquidity pulled, a sharp dump, or risky authorities.

dials.label: Sell past the usual crash time
dials.help: Uses the learner's expected life for coins like this one.

dials.label: Sell after this long with no price
dials.help: Sold at the last known price.

dials.label: Trading fee
dials.help: Platform and pool fees on each buy and each sell.

dials.label: Model price impact from liquidity
dials.help: Bigger bets in thinner pools get worse prices, and a pulled pool pays almost nothing.

dials.label: Extra slippage
dials.help: For delay and other traders, on top of price impact.
